title: the attach by a row's kind and the person's name
line: the fallback that matches a page to a step by the row's kind and the person's name also requires the page's own collection to be the citation's holder collection: two citations of one row at the same holder are not each other's record, and a page of neither citation's collection matches nothing

steps.say: one person's three death-record citations at the same holder: two Kentucky collections and an Ohio one

expect.why: a Kentucky death index page matches only the Kentucky death index citation's step, never the death records citation's nor the Ohio one at the same holder
a page of the death records collection, as the holders registry titles it, matches only the death records citation's step
an Ohio death index page matches only the Ohio citation's step
a page of a collection neither citation names matches nothing
